items.title: Bitcoin Miner MARA Clears Its BTC-Backed Debt and Approves $500 Million Buyback After Q3 Profit
items.summary: Paying off its $750 million in bitcoin-collateralized loans left MARA Holdings with about $350 million from its bitcoin sale, by Unchained’s calculation.

items.title: Coinbase, Kalshi and Jump Trading Urge Judge to Keep Single-Stock Perps Trading
items.summary: Six crypto and trading firms filed a brief backing the CFTC against a trade group of exchanges and brokers that wants perpetual futures on U.S. stocks blocked.

items.title: What Does Coinbase Global (COIN) Regaining New Jersey Staking Access Mean?
items.summary: Coinbase Global (NasdaqGS:COIN) regained approval to offer crypto staking services to New Jersey residents after a statewide ban of more than three years. The New Jersey Bureau of Securities formally withdrew its prior enforcement action against Coinbase, lifting restrictions on the staking product. Access to staking resumes for New Jersey account holders, reopening a segment of Coinbase's US customer base that had been restricted. The end of New Jersey's long staking ban on Coinbase...

items.title: Coinbase Secures Final OCC Approval for Its National Trust Bank
items.summary: Coinbase's new federal trust bank is built for institutional custody, not deposits, and will absorb its New York custody business over three years.

items.title: Is Coinbase Global (COIN) A Bargain After Its Federal Trust Charter Approval?
items.summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) just cleared a major regulatory hurdle, winning full trust charter approval from the U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency. This approval puts its crypto custody and payments activity under a federal banking framework. Despite the trust charter win and a string of product moves, including a Ripple stablecoin tie up and new prediction market scrutiny, Coinbase Global’s recent momentum has cooled. items.title: PNC Bank Lets Corporate Clients Accept USDC Payments in New Coinbase-Powered Pilot
items.summary: USDC sent to participating PNC business clients is swapped 1-to-1 for dollars and lands in a PNC deposit account, with Coinbase running the stablecoin side.
